# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD files the content audit found missing.

dod_flv.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_flv.1.t
	desc = dod_flv.1.d
	flavor = dod_flv.1.f
	event_image = { video = "ip4_mining_scene" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_NORMANDY
		game_date >= 1845.1.1
		NOT = { has_global_variable = dod_flv_normandie }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = dod_flv_normandie
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_flv.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = { name = dod_iron_mines months = 240 }
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
